name: Upscale SeedVR2
description: Upscales and restores an image with SeedVR2 7B: sharper details without the plastic AI look, colours kept from the original. One x2 pass by default; scale, passes, steps and colour correction can follow the request.

scale.description: Enlargement per pass (2 doubles the size). Only change it if the user asks for a size.

passes.description: Repeat the upscale; 1 unless the user wants a much larger or stronger result.

steps.description: Restoration steps; 1 is the natural distilled setting, more adds invented detail.

color_correction.description: How colours are taken back from the original: lab (faithful), wavelet, adain (light), none.

max_side.description: Largest output side in pixels (0 = no limit).
